name: Lumen Plan
tagline: Lighting that makes every room feel right
about: Lumen Plan designs layered lighting room by room: how many lumens, which colour temperature, where fixtures go, which bulbs to buy and how to fix a room that feels flat or harsh.
persona: You are a residential lighting designer: you think in layers (ambient, task, accent), lumens and kelvins, and you can transform a room with lamps and bulbs before anyone touches a wire.

onboarding.title: See your home in a better light
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us about your rooms and what feels off.
bullets: Lumen and kelvin targets per room

tools.title: Light this room
tools.subtitle: Layers, lumens and kelvin

inputs.label: What's there now
inputs.placeholder: one ceiling pendant, one floor lamp

tools.prompt: Design lighting for a {room} of {dims} that currently has: {now}, within the profile's wiring limits. Sections: kv (target total lumens, ambient/task/accent split, recommended kelvin, CRI minimum, dimming?); a table (Layer | Fixture | Position | Lumens | Kelvin | Plug-in or wired); steps to implement cheapest-first; and a callout on the most common mistake in this room type.

tools.title: Why does it feel wrong?
tools.subtitle: Photo of the room at night → diagnosis

inputs.label: Photo of the room with the lights on (evening)

tools.prompt: Diagnose why the room in the photo feels '{feels}'. Sections: text on what the photo shows about light sources, shadows and colour temperature; a table (Problem seen | Cause | Fix | Cost band); a checklist of changes ordered by cost, starting with bulb swaps; and a callout on the one lamp position that would change the room most.

tools.title: Which bulbs?
tools.subtitle: Decode fittings, lumens, kelvin, dimmable
tools.prompt: Recommend bulbs for {fitting} used for {use}, smart preference '{smartpref}'. Sections: kv (lumens, kelvin, CRI, beam angle, dimmable, wattage equivalent, shape); a table (Option | Lumens | Kelvin | Smart? | Price band | Best for); bullets on reading a bulb box; and a callout on dimmer compatibility and flicker.

tools.title: Evening scenes
tools.subtitle: Schedules for wake, work and wind-down

inputs.label: Your lamps & smart devices
inputs.placeholder: 2 smart bulbs living room, bedside lamp on smart plug, kitchen strip

tools.prompt: Create lighting scenes and a schedule using: {lamps}, around this routine: {routine}. Sections: a table (Scene | Time | Lights | Brightness % | Kelvin | Trigger); steps to set it up in a generic smart-home app or with plug-in timers if nothing is smart; bullets on circadian-friendly choices after sunset; and a callout on not relying on scenes for safety lighting on stairs.

tools.title: Lighting shopping list
tools.subtitle: Fixtures and bulbs for the whole home
tools.prompt: Build a lighting shopping list for {rooms} with a budget of {budget} and a {look} look, within the profile's wiring limits. Sections: a table (Room | Item | Type | Lumens/kelvin | Price band | Priority) totalling under budget; cards for 3 splurge-vs-save swaps (meta = saving); a checklist ordered by impact; and a callout on hardwired items that need an electrician.

disclaimer: Hardwired lighting and any electrical work may legally require a qualified electrician in your area. This is design guidance only, not electrical advice.
